paper.specified_model: fixed-corotated elasticity, optionally augmented by a von Mises-type plasticity projection and Newtonian viscosity
omitted_fields: exact plastic projection and yield-stress convention
numerical end-effector trajectory and controller gains
particle-sampling distribution and real-force raw samples

independent_choice.model: perfect J2 radial projection in principal logarithmic elastic strain
independent_choice.volume_rule: retain mean logarithmic strain; plastic projection is isochoric
independent_choice.stress_after_projection: fixed-corotated first Piola stress evaluated from projected F
independent_choice.default_behavior: yield_stress=0 disables projection and preserves prior elastic records

literature_basis.title: Algorithms for static and dynamic multiplicative plasticity that preserve the classical return mapping schemes of the infinitesimal theory
PlasticineLab public von-Mises projection used as implementation precedent, not BladeMaster source

analytical_acceptance.plastic_loading: projected equivalent stress reaches the declared 30 kPa surface
analytical_acceptance.unloading: removing recoverable elastic deformation gives zero stress
analytical_acceptance.rigid_motion: superposed rotation preserves singular values, plastic increment and rotates the projected state
analytical_acceptance.energy: fixed-corotated elastic energy removed by yielding is nonnegative
analytical_acceptance.record_integrity: plastic runs require finite nonnegative per-substep plastic-dissipation telemetry
